text:
Aisha: Quick note before the all-hands: we're testing live captions + automated translation. Start time unchanged. Please read.
Noah: Nice. Are captions turning on for the whole meeting or just leadership?
Aisha: For the full meeting. We'll keep English captions by default and enable auto-translate to DE/FR for the live stream.
Lina: Heads-up: auto-translate added extra latency last week. Can we route translate off the live edge and only for the stream archive?
Evan: We can. Ops can host translation as an async post-process so live has lower latency. That means live captions stay EN, translations appear on YouTube after upload.
CaptionBot: captions: live=true lang=en; translate_async=true langs=[de,fr]; result=queued
Hiro: For accessibility, can we pin captions on the player by default? Some viewers missed enabling them last time.
Aisha: Good idea. Ops, can we default captions=on in the embed?
OpsBot: embed-config: captions_default_on=true for all-hands embed. OK (1.9s)
Noah: If translation is async, can we still surface a short summary in translated text in the chat? Even a bot post would help non-EN watchers.
Evan: Yes  we'll add a post-meeting translated bullet summary. CaptionBot will generate it and post to the thread once translations are ready.
CaptionBot: postprocess: summary_translate queued -> will post to thread when done.
Lina: Quick ops question: will the translation pipeline increase costs materially? Need a rough estimate for finance.
Evan: Minor uptick; we'll attach cost delta to the follow-up doc. For tonight it's covered by infra budget.
Aisha: Also, presenters: avoid overlapping music or background audio during demos  it confuses the captioner. If you must play audio, flag it here and we'll mark that block for post-process captions.
Hiro: Mic test for presenters who haven't joined prep: say "redwood caption test" in the prep room please.
Noah: redwood caption test
Hiro: Got you. Loud/clear on captions.
Aisha: Thanks all. If anything goes sideways on live captions or translations, we'll fall back to audio+recording and post translations after. Drop any urgent accessibility or translation Qs here and I'll escalate. See you in ~10 :raised_hands:
